content: Just launched my new terminal-style blog! Built with Vue 3 + Vite. The developer experience is amazing. 🚀
Working on a new feature for the blog - interactive terminal commands. Stay tuned! 💻
The Vue 3 Composition API is a game-changer for code organization. So much cleaner than Options API.
Deployed to GitHub Pages with GitHub Actions. Zero-config CI/CD is beautiful. ✨
Tip: Use Vite's glob imports to dynamically load markdown files. Perfect for blog systems!
